title: Share of the Drop Returned on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Exchange, by Time the Item Was Away from the Shelf
content:
The share of the drop returned is then fixed by how long the item was away from the shelf, counted from the day it was delivered to the day it was booked in. Where it was away from the shelf longer than the schedule's return window, the stale drop share is returned. Where it was away from the shelf longer than that window divided by the short hold divisor but not longer than the window, the held drop share is returned. In any other case the whole drop share is returned.

The stale drop share is 40 per cent. The held drop share is 70 per cent. The whole drop share is 100 per cent. The short hold divisor is 2.

## The window the time away is measured against

The days away from the shelf are the days from the day the item was delivered to the day it was booked in. They are measured against the return window published against the Northbeam Returns and Restocking schedule the line falls under, and against half that window.

| Return schedule | Return window | That window divided by 2 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | 15 days | 7.5 days |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | 30 days | 15 days |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | 2 days | 1 day |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | 14 days | 7 days |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | 0 days | 0 days |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | 45 days | 22.5 days |

## The three shares

| Days the item was away from the shelf | Share of the drop returned |
| --- | --- |
| longer than the schedule's return window | 40 per cent |
| longer than half that window but not longer than the window | 70 per cent |
| no longer than half that window | 100 per cent |

## Both sides of the thresholds, on hypothetical inputs

Take a drop of 200.00 USD on a schedule whose return window is 20 days.

*The item away from the shelf for 21 days.* Twenty-one is longer than 20, so 40 per cent of the drop is returned, that is 80.00 USD.

*The item away from the shelf for exactly 20 days.* Twenty is not longer than 20 but it is longer than 10, so 70 per cent is returned, that is 140.00 USD.

*The item away from the shelf for 11 days.* Eleven is longer than 10 and not longer than 20, so 70 per cent is returned.

*The item away from the shelf for exactly 10 days.* Ten is not longer than 10, so the whole drop is returned, that is 200.00 USD.
